app_fee.value: A non-refundable application fee of $100 is required for every applicant.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable application fee of $100 is required to submit your application.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are open to international applicants too, but only on demonstrated financial need or hardship, with a one-page description.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers may be requested for applicants with demonstrated financial need or hardship.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are optional, and the committee makes no assumptions if one is left out.
gre_general.quote: As of 2020, Scripps Research has decided to make the submission of GRE scores for both the general and subject-specific exams optional.

toefl_min.value: International applicants must submit a TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo score, but the FAQ says there is no minimum score to apply.
toefl_min.quote: Are there minimum GPA, GRE, TOEFL, IELTS or DET requirements to apply? | No, there are no minimum requirements to apply.

ielts_min.value: International applicants must submit a TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo score, but the FAQ says there is no minimum score to apply.
ielts_min.quote: Are there minimum GPA, GRE, TOEFL, IELTS or DET requirements to apply? | No, there are no minimum requirements to apply.

english_waiver.value: Indian applicants are not exempt: the waiver covers only citizens of listed countries and people who studied full time in those countries, and India is not listed.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL, IELTS or DET requirement may be waived if the applicant meets at least one of these criteria:

also.quote: If you are a citizen of any other English-speaking country not listed above, you are not exempt from the TOEFL requirement.
You studied full time for at least two academic years within the last five years in the United States, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand or Canada (except Quebec).

notes: One interdisciplinary doctoral program at La Jolla, California and Jupiter, Florida. Students do not join a department.
